comment: The policy-level definition describes a registry as a single authoritative source, while implementation may be centralised, federated, or hybrid. “Single source” can still be misread as requiring one physical repository.

anchor.note: p.65 l.Lines 592-600 read as the printed page; section 3.5.1 agrees

public.text: The policy-level definition describes a registry as a single authoritative source, while implementation may be centralised, federated, or hybrid. “Single source” can still be misread as requiring one physical repository.
public.suggestedRevision: Use “authoritative national reference” or “authoritative source arrangement,” and distinguish logical authority from physical storage and organisational distribution.
